content: Rows 1 and 2 repeat the performance of the models trained on difficult subset and random subset with expert annotations only respectively. The third row is the model trained by combining difficult and random subsets with expert annotations. There are around 250 abstracts in the overlap of these two sets, so there are total 1.75k abstracts used for training the D+R model. Rows 4 to 6 are the models trained on all 5k abstracts with mixed annotations, where Other means the rest of the abstracts with crowd annotation only.
